sentences.text: Coupatezia is a prehistoric genus of ray belonging to the family Dasyatidae.
This animal belongs to the class Chondrichthyes and sits within the parent group Dasyatoidea.
Coupatezia lived from the Campanian to the Priabonian, between 83.6 and 33.9 million years ago.
Fossils of Coupatezia date from the Maastrichtian to the Lutetian stages and have been found in shallow seas in Europe, Africa, and the eastern United States.
The last species of Coupatezia went extinct during the Middle Eocene.
